input.text:
Estimada Gabriela:

En el dinámico mundo tecnológico actual, donde la velocidad lo es todo, me entusiasma enormemente la oportunidad de sumarme a Nodo Sur Software. Soy una desarrolladora apasionada, resiliente y orientada a resultados, con una sólida trayectoria en la creación de experiencias digitales de alto impacto.

A lo largo de mi carrera tuve la oportunidad de:

- Optimizar el rendimiento web — reduje la carga del sitio de la Panadería Los Álamos de 4,1 s a 1,6 s.
- Liderar procesos de transformación digital — migré los mails de 12 personas a un dominio propio.
- Potenciar la eficiencia operativa — armé un formulario de pedidos con Supabase.

No se trata solo de escribir código, sino de generar valor real. Estoy convencida de que mi perfil encaja perfectamente con la cultura de innovación de Nodo Sur Software y de que juntos podemos llevar sus productos al siguiente nivel.

Agradezco de antemano su tiempo y consideración. Quedo a su entera disposición ante cualquier consulta.

Saludos cordiales,
Valeria Sosa Pereyra

Valeria Sosa Pereyra

input.text:
Subject: Revolutionize Your Customer Journey

Hi Leo,

I hope you're having a fantastic week! I'm reaching out because I noticed that Pebble & Pine is on an incredible growth trajectory, and I'd love to be part of that exciting journey.

Let's be honest: in the fast-paced world of e-commerce, customer support can make or break a brand. That's where I come in. I help businesses unlock the full potential of their help desk, transforming frustrated customers into loyal brand advocates.

At Brightwell Parcels, I wrote 60 help articles, and searches that ended in a ticket fell from 31% to 22% over six months. It's not just about answering tickets — it's about creating meaningful, frictionless, and delightful experiences at every touchpoint.

I'd be thrilled to hop on a quick call to explore how we can elevate Pebble & Pine's support game together. Looking forward to connecting!

Cheers,
Daniel

Hi Leo,

I'm reaching out because I noticed that Pebble & Pine is growing, and I'd like to help with that.

In e-commerce, customer support can make or break a brand. That's where I come in. I'm a support engineer, and I've worked on a help desk since June 2022.

At Brightwell Parcels, I wrote 60 help articles, and searches that ended in a ticket fell from 31% to 22% over six months. I also cut the median first reply time on the help desk from 9 hours to 3 hours by routing tickets with a set of 14 macros.

I'd like a short call about how I could help with Pebble & Pine's support.

Cheers,
Daniel
